scores.overall_note: impl-20 is a single-screen change-set timeline that fits the brief's understand × temporal-sequence cell almost exactly: the timeline is the dominant initial surface in both 1280x860 and 1440x900 screenshots, causal direction is encoded as 因（更早）/果（更晚） badges and jump cards, and a state-replay table shows evolved state as of the selected change set. The acceptance seed (time structure consistent with change semantics) is not just depicted but validated at startup — strict ts ordering and cause<effect checks feed an error banner (source/app.js:31-53,458-462) — and replay shares the timeline's sort (source/app.js:107-125). Navigation is one-click to any change set or causal neighbor with filters preserving structure via dimming rather than removal, so context loss is minimal. The clear weakness is accessibility: all three a11y receipt checks plus projected type size fail (measurement-summary.json), matching small low-contrast text, sub-24px targets, and timeline nodes excluded from Tab order; layout, responsive-collision, and truncation checks all pass and no visual defects are visible at either viewport. Model-judged proxies only; task time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable in this blind review.
